training.serialization_normalization: Unicode NFC plus collapsing and trimming whitespace
training.eos_loss_weight: run-specific; read from run_manifest.json, not from this policy

evaluation.exact_match: same NFC/whitespace-normalized string; reported separately from semantic verifier
evaluation.generation_termination: EOS termination and max-length failure are reported separately; missing EOS is not correctness

supported_rules.integer: ASCII [+-]?[0-9]+; no decimal point, fraction, exponent, or trailing text
supported_rules.boolean: case-insensitive explicit spelling table only: true, false, yes, no
supported_rules.fraction: ASCII signed numerator over unsigned nonzero denominator; exact rational arithmetic; reduced and unreduced forms equivalent
supported_rules.decimal: ASCII ordinary decimal [+-]?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(\.[0-9]+)?; finite Decimal only; no exponent, underscore, NaN, Infinity, or trailing text
supported_rules.number_list: ASCII comma-separated ordered list; each element is an exact integer, ordinary decimal, or rational; exact rational comparison; no empty/nested/trailing elements
supported_rules.base_number: signed ASCII base-2..16 integer; radix is extracted only from a recognized explicit question template; digits 0-9a-f; no leading zeros except zero
supported_rules.time: 12-hour h:mm AM/PM; hour 1..12, minute 00..59, case-insensitive AM/PM; no 24:00 or alternate formats

evaluation.unsupported_reason: No approved safe, type-specific semantic parser for expression or symbolic_list

fraction_policy: reduced and unreduced equivalent via exact rational arithmetic; denominator is unsigned and nonzero
number_list_policy: ordered comma-separated elements; each element may use integer, ordinary decimal, or rational syntax and all are compared as exact rational values; no sorting or cross-position matching
boolean_case_policy: case-insensitive matching limited to the four listed spellings
base_number_policy: radix 2..16 is taken only from recognized source-question templates; output values are integers and leading zeros are rejected except for zero
time_policy: 12-hour clock only, with exactly one space before AM/PM; case-insensitive meridiem; 24:00 is invalid
normalization_does_not_perform: radix conversion without explicit source metadata
historical_compatibility: Runs labeled provisional-v1-whitespace-nfc-exact remain historical artifacts; re-evaluate into new files before comparing semantic metrics.
warning: This is provisional and must not be reported as final semantic accuracy.
